messages:
emily: Midday support pulse — 32 open tickets, 4 P1s (2 infra, 1 billing, 1 webhook). Quick rundown below.
sam: Taking the P1 infra (#4521). Seeing GPU pool OOM spikes during batching bursts. Starting investigation, ETA ~45m.
jordan: Noted several embedding jobs failing with S3 timeouts — ticket #4599. Suspect eu-west S3 flap. Temporarily throttling retries.
ops-bot: Deploy succeeded: release/redwood-inference@v2.14 — canary -> prod (12:34 PDT) :rocket:
lina: Macro update: edited billing-refund macro to include customer invoice link and clearer steps. Macro ID MACRO-77. PR ready for review.
devon: Quick ask — can someone review PR #621? It's the macro placeholder change plus a tiny runbook tweak. @sam or @jordan?
sam: I can take PR #621 in ~10m. Also, FYI rolling back an autoscaler config that increased batch size too aggressively. That seems linked to the OOMs.
emily: Blocker: customer webhook duplicate callbacks reported by one enterprise account. Logs show 429 retry loop from our rate limiter. Assigned ticket #4608 to me. Need someone to confirm if webhooks are queued twice on retry.
jordan: I'll pin a routing override for embedding ingestion to eu-west for 12h to avoid cross-region reads, then monitor. Will post rollback steps.
lina: Macro note for reviewers — add placeholder variable `{{customer.invoice_id}}` in the refund template. Example snippet: ```Refund steps:
1) Verify invoice {{customer.invoice_id}}
2) Issue refund via Console > Billing
3) Note refund ID in ticket```
devon: Also proposing a one-line runbook addition: check for "missing KV cache" in logs and restart the cache shard. I'll open a tiny PR to support-runbooks.
emily: Please do, I'll merge once CI passes.
sam: P1 infra update: found runaway batch size bump in autoscaler policy, rolled config back. Observability showing token-level latency normalizing. Monitoring for 30m.
ops-bot: Incident update: P1 infra -> stable. Next update scheduled in 30m.
jordan: Closing #4599 after routing change; left notes with timestamps and the reroute command used.
lina: Macro QA pass complete. Will merge PR after devon opens runbook PR.
emily: If no objections I'll hand off remaining P2s to night shift at 19:00 UTC. Any volunteers?
devon: I'll take the EU night handoff (19:00 UTC -> 03:00 UTC).
sam: Passing billing backstop to @lina at 18:50 UTC.
emily: Final — updated support dashboard to surface S3 read timeout spikes; correlated latency with the job failures. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abc123/support-pulse :eyes:
